title: Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)
description:
Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)


100% Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados para atuar diretamente na migração e descomissionamento de sistemas SAP (ECC → S/4HANA) , apoiando o time de Engenharia e Arquitetura de Dados.


O profissional será responsável por executar atividades práticas de integração, mapeamento e migração de dados, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade em todo o processo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o processo de migração de dados entre os ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA.
  • Realizar o mapeamento de origens, transformações e regras de negócio utilizando SAP Data Services (DS) .
  • Conduzir análises de dados e validações de qualidade para garantir consistência e completude.
  • Executar atividades de integração com SAP SLT (fontes S/4) e DS (fontes ECC) .
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na construção de pipelines e processos de carga para o Data Lake (Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL) .
  • Documentar processos, tabelas e fluxos de dados, assegurando rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Apoiar a equipe no descomissionamento dos ambientes legados.


Atividades práticas do dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e ajustar jobs no SAP Data Services .
  • Mapear tabelas de origem SAP e relacionar com os destinos no ambiente cloud.
  • Criar documentação e planilhas de mapeamento e data lineage.
  • Fazer testes de extração, transformação e carga, acompanhando logs e performance.
  • Participar de checkpoints técnicos com equipe de Engenharia e Coordenação.
  • Apoiar análises de erros, inconsistências e ajustes nas integrações.


Experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com SAP Data Services (DS) e integrações SAP ECC / S/4HANA .
  • Conhecimento em integrações SLT e fluxos de replicação entre sistemas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de migração ou descomissionamento de sistemas SAP .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Databricks, Synapse ou Azure SQL .
  • Perfil hands on, analítico e proativo , com boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato (ASAP) .

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft , and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
  • Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.
  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.


Missão do Cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva

e sustentável.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
  • técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
  • Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas
  • regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
  • a confiabilidade dos ativos
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
  • e inspeção.
  • Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
  • mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
  • Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de MoCs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
  • envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e
  • promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
  • Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que
  • embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.


Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Áreas de formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica e Materiais;
  • Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);
  • Disponibilidade para contrato temporário de 9 meses;
  • Experiência Técnica: Metodologias de Confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), Inspeção e Integridade de Equipamentos Estáticos e Dinâmicos, Gestão de Indicadores e Análise de Dados Técnicos e Elaboração de Procedimentos Técnicos e Apoio a MoCs;
  • Certificações: CREA
  • Idiomas: Inglês Básico/Avançado;
  • Soft skills: Engajamento, protagonismo, foco em resultado, iniciativa e assertividade.
  • Hard skills: Conhecimento/Experiência com NR 13 e Experiência com Inspeção de Caldeiras e vasos de pressão.

Camaçari- BA - Brasil

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., , job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Video Lead
description:
Impact3 - Video Lead

Join Impact3 – Help Us Change the Game in Crypto

Location: 100% Remote


How to Apply

  • Please submit a 2–3 minute Loom video highlighting your experience with video editing, including the tools you use, how you leverage AI, and your overall creative process. Be sure to attach your portfolio as well.


About Impact3

Impact3 is a growth marketing agency of crypto-native marketers dedicated to building trusted brands in the trustless technology space - aka crypto.

We specialize in social media management, public relations, paid advertising, visual production, strategy, go-to-market campaigns and more.


The Role

We don’t want just a \"Video Editor.\" We want a Video Architect. You should be someone who looks at a manual 20-hour editing task and finds a way to do it in 4 hours at a higher quality using your custom AI tech stack.

As the Video Lead at Impact3, you are the architect of our visual narrative. You don’t just \"edit video\", you build the engine that produces high-end, viral-ready content at the speed of the internet. You will lead a team of creators to transform complex crypto concepts into hyper-realistic, professional video assets.

This is a leadership role, but it is also hands-on. You must be comfortable leading a team while actively working inside Premiere Pro and After Effects yourself.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between \"standard social video\" and \"cinematic AI production,\" ensuring Impact3 remains the most innovative agency in the Web3 space.


  • Hyper-Realistic Storyboarding: Lead the pre-production process by using AI to generate high-fidelity, professional-grade storyboards that look like final frames. You will set the visual \"North Star\" for every project before a single second of video is rendered.
  • Production Leadership (Hands-On): Manage and mentor a team of video editors, ensuring all outputs meet \"Senior\" quality standards while maintaining an AI-first workflow. You must be capable of stepping in, solving technical challenges directly, and setting the creative and technical bar through execution.
  • End-to-End AI Integration: Own the process of incorporating generative AI (Video-to-Video, Text-to-Video, AI Voiceover, and Generative Audio) into the traditional post-production pipeline.
  • Process Architecture: Document and refine the \"Impact3 Video Playbook\"—creating scalable workflows that allow the team to pivot from TikTok/Reels to high-end brand films instantly.
  • Quality Control: Act as the final gatekeeper for visual polish, advanced motion graphics, color grading, and \"the vibe,\" ensuring everything is culturally relevant to the crypto audience.


Key Skills and Qualifications

  • Proficient English Level: You must be able to communicate complex creative visions and lead meetings in English fluently. This is non-negotiable.
  • Vast AI Knowledge: You must demonstrate a documented history of using AI tools (e.g., Runway, Pika, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) to solve production bottlenecks and elevate visual quality.
  • Capacity to Lead: You have experience managing creative teams, giving actionable feedback, setting standards, and taking ownership of deadlines.
  • Storyboarding Mastery: Ability to create professional, hyper-realistic boards that accurately represent lighting, composition, and movement.
  • Adobe Proficiency (Premiere + After Effects): You must be highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and advanced in After Effects. After Effects proficiency is mandatory for professional-grade motion graphics, compositing, and AI-integrated post-production workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Strength: You are not just a manager—you are capable of executing complex edits, building motion systems, and solving production challenges directly.
  • (Nice to have) Crypto-Native Fluency: Understanding \"Crypto Twitter\" culture, memes, and the visual language of Web3 is a major plus but not a dealbreaker if you are a fast learner.


How Our Team Works (Our Ethos)

  • We’re in this together: no silos, no egos; we support each other.
  • Take ownership: be accountable, act like an owner, go the extra mile.
  • Get shit done: move fast, focus on execution, learn by doing.
  • Simplify & systemize: build processes, document workflows, work smarter.
  • Lead by example: learn first, then teach and raise the bar.
  • Speak up: over-communicate, ask for help, share ideas openly.
  • Get obsessed: live the space, bring curiosity, chase excellence.


What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and challenging role in a rapidly evolving industry.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Remote work: our team spans Canada, USA, Mexico, Spain, Italy, Bulgaria, Albania, Macedonia, Romania, India, Portugal, Brazil, Argentina and more.
  • Annual retreat to build relationships and plan for growth.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.

title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.


Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);

  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);

title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:

The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language
  • Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular
  • Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams
  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains
  • Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines
  • Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows
  • Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability
  • Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep, production-grade experience with PHP
  • Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally
  • Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems
  • Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns
  • Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring
  • Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools
  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market
  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight
  • Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements


Desired Experience

  • Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus
  • Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards
  • Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale

  • Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!

description:

The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.

  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).

  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity

  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

description:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

title: Monitor (a) de Pesquisa Pleno - CRA II
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO


Gerenciar os centros de pesquisa de um determinado estudo e realizar monitoria dos centros de pesquisa do Brasil e/ou LATAM. Suporte aos monitores CRA I.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Realizar visitas de monitoria on-site ou remotas (visitas de seleção, iniciação, periódicas e encerramento) de acordo com o escopo de trabalho contratado e os requisitos regulatórios, ou seja, as diretrizes de Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e da Conferência Internacional de Harmonização (ICH).
  • Trabalhar com os centros para adaptar, impulsionar e rastrear o plano de recrutamento dos participantes de acordo com as necessidades do projeto para aumentar a previsibilidade.
  • Administrar protocolo e treinamento de estudo relacionado aos centros designados e estabelecer linhas regulares de comunicação com os centros para gerenciar expectativas e problemas contínuos do projeto.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e integridade das práticas do centro relacionadas à condução adequada do protocolo e adesão aos regulamentos aplicáveis. Escalar problemas de qualidade conforme apropriado.
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Certificar-se de que cópias/originais (conforme necessário) dos documentos do centro estejam disponíveis para arquivamento no TMF e verificar se o ISF é mantido de acordo com GCP/ICH e requisitos regulatórios locais.
  • Criar e manter documentação apropriada relativa ao gerenciamento do centro, monitorar resultados de visitas e planos de ação, enviando relatórios de monitoria, gerando cartas de acompanhamento e outra documentação de estudo necessária.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores.
  • Colaborar e estabelecer ligação com os membros da equipe de estudo para apoio à execução do projeto, conforme apropriado.
  • Se aplicável, ser responsável pela gestão financeira do centro.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA I, incluindo a realização de visitas de co-monitoria e treinamento.


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica

Graduação na Área da Saúde (Farmácia, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem, Biologia, Biomedicina, entre outras), pós-graduação na área preferencialmente, formação em pesquisa clínica


- Requisitos Técnicos:

Disponibilidade para viajar pelo menos 60% do tempo.


- Experiência:

Pelo menos 18 meses de experiência em pesquisa, experiência prévia em monitoria.


- Idiomas:

Inglês: Avançado.

Espanhol necessário para monitores LATAM.


- Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Gerenciamento do tempo
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Coerência

Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor.

Aqui você terá grandes desafios, trabalhará em colaboração com um time diverso e contribuirá para o futuro do e-commerce no Brasil, criamos impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Modelo de Trabalho

Nossos times que atuam nos centros logísticos, trabalham 100% presencial. Assim garantimos a qualidade da nossa logística e também fortalecemos nossa cultura de colaboração e agilidade.

Qual será a sua missão

Você será responsável por liderar a equipe de gestão de espaço e atividades, respondendo ao coordenador de Inventário. Nossos centros de distribuição são o coração da operação em expansão da Shopee, onde controlamos o fluxo de mercadorias. Nesses locais, as equipes são responsáveis por armazenar produtos, separar pedidos, embalar e preparar para envio.

Esses centros são ambientes dinâmicos e rápidos, onde o cumprimento rigoroso de políticas e processos é essencial. Por isso, buscamos líderes capacitados que garantam a eficiência e a qualidade das operações, sempre mantendo o foco na satisfação do cliente e na excelência do trabalho das equipes.
